messages:
li: Quick note — during q4f16 conversion of orion-lite we see zh->en detok flips: fullwidth quotes (U+201C/U+201D) become ASCII '"' and spacing changes. Slice BLEU down ~2.1 on punctuation-heavy set.

sophia: can you paste a repro?

li: repro:
input: 我說：「今天的天氣很好。」
fp16: “Today the weather is great.”
q4f16: "Today the weather is great."

eva: Did you dump token probs? sounds like a tiny score crossover at punctuation.

li: yep — fp16 top token after opening quote is U+201C; q4f16 top is U+0022. delta small (~0.003).

marcel: likely numeric sensitivity from per-group scaling in converter. I'll run full-FP accumulation test and try softmax fallback.

sophia: add a micro-slice "cjk_quotes" into eval harness and report both pre/post-detok BLEU.

li: added. pre-detok drop 2.4 BLEU, post-detok 1.8. token-swap rate 0.78% (58/7400).

raj: gating rule proposal: fail canary if slice drop >1.0 BLEU AND swap_rate >0.5%.

marcel: working on converter tweak to preserve logits for high-entropy punctuation. will post numbers.

li: action items: add slice PR, marcel run numeric sensitivity, raj hold wide rollout on rule, li run swap script on canary.

sophia: thanks — keep updates here.
